subject: Block provenance anchors: give the fold a stable per-block identity
description:
The fold has no stable block identity, so per-block presentation state is POSITION-keyed. The
TUI's `user_folds` overlay is the live example: a fold gesture can land on the wrong block
across an equal-count tail reshape. Tolerable for gestures; insufficient for any presentation
layer that needs strong consistency with `Vec<Bv>` changes.

Surfaced in the #167 review, 2026-08-21.

Sketch: anchor = (first contributing line's byte offset, emit-ordinal within that line) — the
same `(at, index)` vocabulary attachments already use. Same anchor across re-emission; on
coalesce, take the first constituent's anchor. Consumers join old-by-anchor against
new-by-anchor per delta.

Cost: roughly 10 bytes per block persisted, so ONE FOLD_VERSION bump — which is why it should
ride #167's build rather than land alone.

NEEDS AN OWNER DECISION: adopt into #167's scope, or file as its own GitHub issue and schedule
separately. Do not start until that is answered.
